title: SOMA sign-in: Google branding
_note: Project TestingTheCloud, Google account authuser=3. App name was Playmaker. Run after the JavaScript-origins Save, which adds most authorized domains; somastudios.ai must be an authorized domain for the home page (Google: 'missing domain name' otherwise). No logo: uploading one sends the app to Google's brand verification.

steps.instruction: Yeshie set App name to SOMA (it was Playmaker), home page https://somastudios.ai, privacy policy https://somastudios.ai/privacy/, terms https://somastudios.ai/terms/, and added somastudios.ai under Authorized domains. Check them, then click Save.
